Variables._comment_region: Two region vars: backend S3/SES helpers read RAILBACK_AWS_REGION; the vendored @railback/db S3 connector reads RAILBACK_S3_REGION. Both default to eu-north-1, but set BOTH explicitly so nothing surprises us if a default ever changes.
Variables._comment_s3: Bucket confirmed 2026-07-11: the shared account has a bucket literally named 'railback' (eu-north-1). NOTE: it is also used by a Cognito browser-upload demo that uploads ACL:public-read. RailBack's presigned POST sets NO ACL (objects stay private) — do NOT change that. Verify Block-Public-Access is ON before storing PII under raw/ belege/.
Variables._comment_cognito: DEMO-ONLY (set by account owner 2026-07-11). Probed: the dispatcher's own IAM principal (s241539) is DENIED s3:PutObject on raw/ belege/, so a presigned POST it signs is rejected by S3. The Cognito unauth pool role IS allowed PutObject on those prefixes. Setting this makes upload-presign sign with the Cognito identity so the upload endpoint works over the Function URL. Scope is presign-signing only (see lib/src/storage/s3/credentials.ts); direct GetObject stays on the default chain because the Cognito role cannot GetObject. Unset to revert to the default credential chain.
Variables._comment_ses: SES confirmed 2026-07-11 via emailSES lambda: railback.de is a verified sender identity AND the account is OUT of sandbox (send to arbitrary external recipient accepted). Use an @railback.de from-address. test@railback.de is proven; switch to noreply@railback.de only if the full DOMAIN identity (not just the email identity) is verified.
Variables._comment_extractor: Extractor slot confirmed 2026-07-11: s243184 (granted, Python, update-permission verified). deploy-extractor.sh deploys the Python ticket-extractor here. If empty, upload-confirm skips extraction (tickets must use the MANUAL_ROUTE flow).
